text: わかいひとは　みんな　とかいに　いきたがる　けど　あたしは　ずっと　ここにいたいな！

structure.jp: わかいひとは　みんな
とかいに　いきたがる　けど
structure.en: want to go to the city, but

structure.jp: あたしは　ずっと　ここにいたいな！
structure.en: I want to stay here forever!

patterns.name: 〜たがる
patterns.explanation: たがる is used for what other people seem to want to do. いきたがる = '(they) want to go'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb says what the speaker wants to do. ここにいたい = 'I want to stay here'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two parts with 'but'. いきたがる　けど = 'they want to go, but'.
